ScheduledTransfer.description: A transfer created from a scheduled event on a contract, e.g. Coupon, Dividend Return, Fixed Rate Return

UnscheduledTransfer.description: An ad-hoc transfer instigated by a party to the contract e.g. Recall, Return.

ContingentTransfer.description: A transfer created from a contingent event on a contract, e.g. Corporate Action, Credit Event or Exercise
